source_refs.note: Topic 2.4.1.1 if Statement as printed (PDF 41, printed 38).

blocks.text: The if statement lets us make decisions based on conditions. If the condition is true, it runs a block of code.

#  Syntax of if statement if condition:
If condition:
    #  code to run if the condition is true

blocks.title: Book correction
blocks.text: The syntax line is printed as If condition: with a capital I. Python keywords are lower-case, so it must be if condition: (If raises a SyntaxError).
Example: If the temperature is above 30 degrees, we print a message.
